sents.text: Gold and Silver. A quick trip down memory lane.
The year two thousand. A brand new region, and one hundred new monsters to catch.
Grass, fire, or water. Which starter did you pick?
For the first time, the game knew if it was day or night.
Whitney's Miltank and its Rollout ended a lot of winning streaks.
A red Gyarados was waiting at the Lake of Rage.
Beat the league, and surprise! A whole second region. Sixteen badges!
And at the very top of Mount Silver, Red was waiting.
Gold or Silver? Comment your version, and follow R G Brick and Stick Verse for more memory lane.
